events.title: Internet Explorer 1.0 released
events.summary: Microsoft shipped Internet Explorer 1.0 on August 16, 1995 in the Windows 95 Plus! pack — its first browser and the opening move in the browser wars with Netscape.
events.about: IE 1.0 was a licensed Mosaic derivative that brought the web to Windows users inside Microsoft's ecosystem. It was slow and basic at first, but it came bundled with Windows — a distribution advantage that eventually reshaped the entire software industry.

narrative.whyChosen: Microsoft's browser entry turned the web into a platform battle between two software giants.
narrative.whyImportant: Bundling and OS integration made IE the default for hundreds of millions of PCs.
narrative.problemSolved: Windows users needed a built-in way to browse the web without buying a separate Netscape install.
